fusions.name: Filament Tether
fusions.desc: Fires a shot trailing fine strands that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 20% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bristle Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone of fine bristles ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything caught, with a 20% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangle Wire
fusions.desc: Strings a line of strands 6 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Crosshair Strands
fusions.desc: Conjures a sight strung with fine hairs: your critical chance rises by 6%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, and each kill returns 2 health.
